This endpoint is expected to be hidden or rejected on the pinned DLL; do not retry or substitute destructive actions. If the tool is not exposed, explicitly record that quarantine result in end_turn. Do not call research_target or tend; those are out of scope and already covered. After the gate, make only safe ordinary survival writes from observed state. Never fabricate IDs or coordinates.
